BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF SUPPLIES OR SERVICES REQUIRED AND THE INTENDED USE:

The United States Coast Guard Academy requires snow hauling and disposal services to remove excessive accumulated snow from roadways, parking areas, sidewalks, and operational areas throughout the installation. Accumulated snow has exceeded on-site storage capacity and is creating unsafe conditions including:  Restricted emergency vehicle access  Reduced parking availability  Obstructed pedestrian routes  Limited visibility at intersections  Increased slip, trip, and fall hazards The contractor shall provide all labor, equipment, and supervision necessary to load, transport, and dispose of snow at Governmentdesignated disposal locations along the Thames River waterfront within USCGA property. The Connecticut Department of Energy and Environmental Protection (CT DEEP) has authorized emergency in-water snow disposal upon submission of notification.

Last Updated 11/01/24 RATIONALE FOR JUSTIFICATION TYPE SELECTED ABOVE TO INCLUDE RELEVANT INFORMATION GAINED THROUGH YOUR MARKET RESEARCH TO SUPPORT THE JUSTIFICATION TYPE:

The Government is soliciting a quotation from one source due to the urgent and time-sensitive nature of the requirement and the need to restore sanitary sewer service immediately to prevent further sewage backup, facility damage, and potential health/safety impacts.

This justification is prepared in accordance with:

FAR 13.106-1(b)(1)(i), which states:

“For purchases not exceeding the simplified acquisition threshold, the contracting officer may solicit from one source if the contracting officer determines that the circumstances of the contract action deem only one source reasonably available.” Soliciting from a single source is justified due to urgent operational requirements and limited contractor availability during extraordinary winter conditions.

Specifically: A. Urgent Public Safety Requirement Accumulated snow presents an immediate threat to:

Installation personnel safety Emergency vehicle access Mission readiness Safe operation of critical facilities Delay in removing accumulated snow would significantly impair installation operations and increase safety risks.

B. Limited Contractor Availability Snow hauling requires specialized equipment including: Dump trucks Front-end loaders Heavy equipment operators During regional snow emergencies, the availability of contractors with immediately deployable equipment is extremely limited. Only contractors with: Existing heavy hauling capability Immediate availability Local presence can perform the work within the required timeframe.

C. Time Constraints Prevent Full Competition Full and open competition would require additional time for: Solicitation issuance Response period Proposal evaluation Contract award These delays would prevent timely mitigation of hazardous conditions and impair Government operations.

D. Operational and Installation Access Considerations Contractors must be capable of: Immediate mobilization Operating within a secure federal installation Working under COR direction Performing disposal at Government-designated waterfront locations Last Updated 11/01/24 Not all contractors possess the capability or availability to perform these services immediately.

Based on market conditions and urgency, only limited sources are reasonably available to perform the work immediately.

This acquisition will be conducted consistent with FAR Part 13 to the maximum extent practicable.

The Government will determine price reasonableness using the Independent Government Estimate (IGE), historical pricing for similar work, and comparison to commercial pricing as available.
